milestone.title: test infrastructure quality — split lib_api.rs mega-helper and dedup seed/gig-git helpers across suites

intent.outcome: Touching common test helpers no longer forces 50+ integration test binaries to recompile, and the seed-handoff / git-init helpers live in one place the suites consume — not three.

problem.description: crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs is 1020+ lines (single file covering PlanContext bootstrap, milestone/step/wp/ac mutations, validate, git, JSON parsing, capture_stdio via dup2, and run_with_retry) imported by 50+ test files. Adding one helper recompiles every test binary that depends on it. The file also contains `seed_handoff_gate(env: &TestEnv)` duplicated verbatim in crates/mp/tests/suites/plan_diff.rs:33-50 and crates/mp/tests/suites/digest.rs:6-43, and `init_git` repeated in crates/mp/tests/suites/git_suggest.rs:6-23 and crates/mp/tests/suites/p12_recommendation_batch.rs:5+.

in_scope: Split crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs into per-domain submodules under crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/{ctx.rs, mutation.rs, io.rs, capture.rs, seed.rs, git.rs}. The current lib_api.rs file becomes either a thin re-export shim or is removed once every importer migrates to the submodules.
Move capture_stdio (lib_api.rs:1024-1108, dup2-based stdout helper) into its own module so it does not pull in the rest of lib_api.rs.
Extract seed_handoff_gate + init_git + capture_stdio as methods on TestEnv (or under tests/common/seed.rs / tests/common/git.rs) and update the three suite files to import from one source.
Add a no-op smoke test that asserts the new module structure compiles and the consumers still resolve (catches mistakes when one suite forgets the import path).
Add a CHANGELOG entry under the next milestone release noting the test-helper refactor; no behavior change.
out_of_scope: Redesigning the TestEnv or mp_bin_snapshot contract.
Adding new helpers; the refactor is purely structural.
Touching crates/raul/tests/ which has its own (smaller) common test scaffold.

acceptance_criteria.description: crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs is no longer a single mega-file: it either holds only re-exports or is gone in favor of crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/<domain>.rs.
acceptance_criteria.verification: wc -l crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs (must be < 100 lines OR the file is removed and 50+ consumers route to crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/<domain>.rs).

acceptance_criteria.description: The seed_handoff_gate / init_git / capture_stdio helpers are defined once (single source of truth) and every prior duplicate suite imports from that one path.
acceptance_criteria.verification: rg -n 'fn seed_handoff_gate|fn init_git|fn capture_stdio' crates/mp/tests/ returns one definition per helper, plus its tests.

acceptance_criteria.description: Editing one helper module's body (e.g. ctx.rs) compiles only the tests that depend on it, not the full 50+ binary chain. The refactor does not increase total test compile time.
acceptance_criteria.verification: touch crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/ctx.rs && cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/lib_api/)' (only ctx-touching tests rebuild; full make test wall-clock drop vs baseline is recorded in CHANGELOG).

acceptance_criteria.description: All previously-passing mp/raul integration tests still pass after the refactor.
acceptance_criteria.verification: make test (exit 0 on the same tests that exited 0 at baseline).

work_packages.name: lib_api split

steps.action: Verify editing one helper module's body compiles only the tests that depend on it; record wall-clock delta in CHANGELOG.
steps.tests: touch crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/ctx.rs && cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/lib_api/)' (only ctx-touching tests rebuild)

steps.action: Extract seed_handoff_gate, init_git into crates/mp/tests/common/seed.rs and crates/mp/tests/common/git.rs (or as TestEnv methods); refactor suites/plan_diff.rs, suites/digest.rs, suites/git_suggest.rs, suites/p12_recommendation_batch.rs to import from one source.
steps.tests: rg -n 'fn seed_handoff_gate|fn init_git' crates/mp/tests/ returns exactly one definition per helper

steps.action: Run the full mp/raul test suite plus a no-op smoke that asserts the new module structure compiles and the consumers still resolve.
